description: Machine-readable lane ownership for the dual-lane Codex<->Claude collaboration. owner-of.ps1 resolves a repo-relative path to codex|claude|shared|unknown. Resolution order: exact override > shared > lane globs > unknown. Consumers (lane-commit.ps1, the pre-commit lane-guard) MUST treat 'unknown' as a HARD BLOCK -- add the path to a lane's globs or to overrides rather than bypassing. Glob forms supported: 'prefix/**' (prefix match), '**/*.ext' (suffix match), exact path.
_lanePrecedence: Inter-lane precedence when two lanes' globs overlap the SAME path. Before this key existed, owner-of.ps1 iterated lanes in JSON property order and returned the first match, so codex:tools/gpu/** beat claude:tools/** only because codex happens to be listed first (OWN-1-PRECEDENCE: 'undocumented luck, not policy'). This declares the SAME resolution explicitly; behaviour is unchanged. A lane absent from this list is tried after every listed lane, in JSON order.

codex.role: implementer (playback + recon + GPU) -- owns the playback/present/GPU implementation surfaces for the beyond-36 goal (Layi 2026-07-02, to enable autonomous multi-hour Codex commits). NOTE: platform/qt/MainWindow.cpp + src/mlv/* carry FOREIGN uncommitted WIP in the MAIN tree -- Codex must commit ONLY in its side worktrees, NEVER run lane-commit in the main tree, and NEVER git add -A.

claude.role: reviewer + coordinator + gate/coordination tooling (platform/qt + tools/gpu reassigned to codex 2026-07-02; claude retains batch CLI, gate/profiling/testing tooling, docs, dual-lane infra)

sharedNote: Phase 2: cross-lane interface headers (src/mlv/video_mlv.h, src/mlv/llrawproc/llrawproc.h, *.pro) may be promoted to 'shared' to require a Two-Key: trailer when edited. Left empty initially to avoid friction on Codex's routine header edits.
